PlatformCompaniesPage.title: Companies
PlatformCompaniesPage.description: Every company on this installation. Suspending one blocks its people from signing in; their customers' messages keep arriving.
PlatformCompaniesPage.confirmSuspendDescription: {{companyName}} will be blocked from signing in immediately, including anyone already signed in. Their customers' messages keep arriving, so nothing is lost.
PlatformCompaniesPage.confirmReactivateDescription: {{companyName}} will be able to sign in again straight away.
PlatformCompaniesPage.statusErrorFallback: Could not change this company's status.

PlatformPlansPage.title: Plans
PlatformPlansPage.description: The price list offered to every company. Creating a plan publishes it to PayPal.
PlatformPlansPage.priceIsFinal: The price and billing period can't be changed after the plan is created, because PayPal charges against them. To change a price, create a new plan.
PlatformPlansPage.restrictFeatures: Limit this plan to specific features
PlatformPlansPage.emptyDescription: Create a plan to start charging companies for their workspace.

CompanyFeaturesDialog.title: Features for {{companyName}}
CompanyFeaturesDialog.description: Turn features on or off for this company. Anything you set here overrides their plan. Companies with no plan get everything.
CompanyFeaturesDialog.loadError: Could not load this company's features.
